edges.mechanism: Accelerator shipments are a direct driver of AI cluster buildout.
Leading-edge foundry capacity is required for accelerator supply.
HBM availability shapes accelerator throughput and package mix.
Packaging bottlenecks can cap delivered accelerator volumes.
Cluster deployment materially increases facility power needs.
Large datacenter loads pressure transmission and interconnect capacity.
When load rises faster than firm low-carbon supply, gas can fill the gap.
Transmission and electrical buildout tend to increase copper intensity.
